subject: Enterprise onboarding: account boundaries, service accounts, and SSO/SCIM next steps

Subject: kickoff: SSO/SCIM, service accounts, network boundaries

Hi Vivek/Monica,

Thanks for the quick onboarding kickoff today. To keep momentum, can we capture the minimal set of artifacts GreenLeaf needs to deliver and what Redwood needs to configure on our side? High-level asks from our side:

- SSO (SAML) metadata and expected assertion attributes (email, groups, employee_id)
- SCIM mapping for managing user lifecycle from our IdP to Redwood (creation, deprovisioning)
- Service account patterns for programmatic ingestion (CI/CD runners + data ingestion pipelines)
- IP allowlist ranges and any egress rules required for private deploys
- Any org/role policies we should predefine to align with our AD groups

We have a tentative go-live window of July 19 but procurement needs a checklist for security/compliance to attach to the PO. Attaching current IdP metadata and our network CIDRs in my next email.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Head of Platform Engineering
GreenLeaf Health

Hi Emily — great meeting. I captured a compact onboarding plan below and attached a one-page checklist for procurement. Please review and confirm owners for the items we call out.

Summary of what Redwood needs from GreenLeaf (deliverables):
- IdP SAML metadata (XML) + expected NameID and attribute statements (email, groups, employee_id)
- SCIM credentials (client ID/secret) and preferred attribute mapping file (we support userName, displayName, givenName, familyName, active, emails, groups)
- List of service accounts that need inbound/outbound tokens and their intended scopes (e.g., ingestion-service@greenleaf, ci-runner@greenleaf)
- Network CIDRs for IP allowlisting + point-of-contact for firewall rules (nat/egress)
- Any internal org policies or group names you want mirrored in Redwood RBAC (e.g., #sre, #product-ops)

Redwood deliverables and timeline (target Jul 19 go-live):
- Day 0 (upon receiving IdP metadata & SCIM creds): Configure SAML endpoint + test assertions (1-2 business days)
- Day 2-5: Wire SCIM provisioning in a staging org; dry-run provisioning from your test user base
- Day 6-8: Create service accounts and scoped API keys; recommend least-privilege policies (we'll send policy templates)
- Day 9-12: Configure network allowlist in your region + canary rollout to a single team
- Day 13-15: Post-rollout validation and sign-off

Open questions for GreenLeaf (please reply inline):
1) Do you have a staging IdP environment we can use for dry runs?
2) What CIDR ranges will we need to allow (public-facing vs private peering)?
3) Any regulatory constraints on token lifetimes or service account key rotation?

Attachments I included: redwood-sso-scim-checklist.xlsx (procurement-friendly), network-allowlist-template.txt (format for CIDRs).

If that's aligned I'll schedule a short technical sync (30 min) with your SRE and our infra engineer this week.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni

- We'll include an 'Org policy mapping' doc; Vivek, can you attach the policy templates mentioned above?
